pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql (DEFAULT 0, CHECK); test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing rows are 0 and done=2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order.
test 'AC-3' checks done-only, ✓ prefix, id order (marks 3 then 1).
test 'AC-4' checks all items in id order with ✓ only on done ones.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav for each view and the default view; the current view is <strong>, not a link.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__; the code uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views.

traffic/routes.json has the routes, but the final commit 9c0773c ('Follow-up edits') deleted the only test that named AC-8 ('AC-8: synthetic traffic requests the done and all views'). No remaining test names AC-8 or fails if the routes are removed. The spec doesn't mark it 'verified by review'.

findings.what: The last commit, 9c0773c 'Follow-up edits', silently deleted the AC-8 test. Nothing now checks that /?view=done and /?view=all are in traffic/routes.json, so AC-8 has no evidence. The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and 'covers AC-1 to AC-8', and both claims are false.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-8 test, or add an equivalent one that fails when either route is missing from traffic/routes.json. Don't delete tests in a commit titled 'Follow-up edits'.

findings.what: The PR body claims test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8 and that no tests were deleted. The final commit deleted the AC-8 test. The commit message 'Follow-up edits' also hides the deletion.
findings.fix: Correct the PR body after restoring the test, and use a descriptive commit message.

findings.what: The deletion left a stray blank line before the closing `});` of the first describe block.

lenses.note: The spec has an owner go, and the decisions are followed: the default view is open and the view is a GET query parameter.
AC-1 to AC-7 are met with tests. AC-8 has the route entries but no remaining test. Every state-table row has a test.
The tests check behaviour. The AC-8 test was deleted in the final commit. I did not run the suite, because the Workers test environment is covered by CI per the project's check-fast.sh.
The README describes the views. CLAUDE.md and the README require new routes in routes.json, and that is done.
The query construction uses only fixed strings from VIEWS, and the view value is validated with Object.hasOwn. The extra COUNT query for the empty-table message is correct. I found no defects.
No injection: the view is allow-listed and titles are escaped. The traffic-check regex now allows `?` but still refuses spaces and `#`.
src/index.js renders HTML, so the change has a user interface. The nav is simple and the current view is not a link. I saw no issues.
The change has a UI. I could not run a browser, and the tests check the rendered HTML.
The PR's claims about deleted tests and AC-8 coverage are false. The other claims match the diff.
